snippet.title: MYTHS AND MONSTERS in Little Alchemy 2
snippet.description:
In this special video, I show you how to make all myths and monsters in Little Alchemy 2. Check out the step by step guide with the easiest way to get all 110 items of the content pack for Little Alchemy 2.

You can buy the Myths and Monsters content pack within the Little Alchemy 2 mobile app on Android and iOS. Once you have installed it, you get four new basic elements: evil, good, immortality, and monster. Combine them with other elements and unlock 110 additional items!

----------------------------------------
